human_sources.title: Evans–Kishimoto type argument for actions of discrete amenable groups on McDuff factors
human_sources.role: The coefficient-weighted tower correction is the classical Shapiro construction in [Ocneanu] below, Chapter 7.2, and [Masuda], Lemma 3.4. Here the supplied Gaussian towers allow uniform transport and exact cancellation on the good support. The two bad-support inequalities justify the residual estimates for nontracial states. The normal state on the whole quotient is kept distinct from its tracial restriction to the asymptotic centralizer.
